subject: Other Corridors Zoning Proposal
overview: The committee reviewed proposed zoning updates for city corridors and discussed preliminary frameworks for Tufts institutional zoning and parking management. Members reported the Other Corridors draft to the full City Council to initiate the formal referral process to the Community Development Board.

items.title: Tufts Institutional District Progress Check
items.summary: The committee discussed a preliminary framework for a new institutional zoning district for Tufts University, focusing on topographical height regulations and reconciling boundary differences with Somerville.

items.title: Parking and Transportation Demand Management Debrief
items.summary: Staff debriefed a recent public forum on parking management, reviewing a menu of strategies to transition from conventional parking minimums to more flexible, demand-based regulations.

items.title: Other Corridors Zoning Proposal
items.summary: Approved reporting the Other Corridors draft out of committee following a review of mixed-use extensions on Boston Avenue and efforts to align Broadway zoning with Somerville's standards.

items.title: Performance Standards and Development Incentives
items.summary: The consultant detailed performance standards including height step-backs for residential transitions, green score incentives, and requirements for active ground-floor frontages.
